# sf_raw_min — synthetic Screaming Frog export (K-05)

Eight CSVs with the real SF column headers and fully synthetic rows on
`example.test`. No client data. They exist so the SF projection / import path
runs on CI and fresh clones: the live-crawl tests (`demo-*` aliases) skip
everywhere except the operator's machine.

Generated by `tests/fixtures/sf_raw_min/build.py`; edit the generator, not the
CSVs. Covered branches: indexable + non-indexable HTML, 301 / 404 responses,
an external redirect, structured data with an error, missing title / meta /
duplicate H1, and four issue-overview rows across the priority levels.
